feed.title: MMI | UNCC
feed.subtitle: Our research focuses on fundamental understandings of structures and properties in materials, with the goal of discovery and design for high pressure physics and chemistry, organic crystal polymorphism, defects in materials, and materials informatics.

entry.title: Moving to UNCC
entry.content: We are glad to announce that the Zhu Group has moved to the Department of Mechanical Engineering and Energy Science (MEES) of University of North Carolina at Charlotte (UNCC). We will start a new journey at Charlotte!
entry.summary: We are glad to announce that the Zhu Group has moved to the Department of Mechanical Engineering and Energy Science (MEES) of University of North Carolina at Charlotte (UNCC). We will start a new journey at Charlotte!
